about: The stone's drawing fitted as a field (devtools/splats-field-fit.mjs, wash, 16751 discs, 48 views; held-out error 3.521 against 4.453 without view dependence, 26.339 for blank paper). Packed 19 bytes a disc: place (3 × int16 over ±2.5), normal (octahedral, 2 bytes), size (× 0.0002), nine view terms and the constant-only baseline's term (a byte each over −12…12).
